enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom for the night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up over body. Close eyes. Turn body onto right side. Remain still. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Turn body onto back. Move left arm under pillow. Remain still. Turn body onto left side. Adjust pillow with right hand. Remain still. Move right leg out from under blanket. Pull blanket back over leg. Turn body onto back. Turn head on pillow. Remain still. Keep breathing steadily. Remain lying in bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on edge of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom door. Push door open. Reach to wall. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet both hands under water. Cup water in hands. Splash water onto face. Rub face with hands. Turn off tap. Pick up towel from rack. Wipe face with towel. Hang towel back on rack. Pick up toothbrush from holder. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush under water. Turn off tap. Pick up toothpaste tube. Squeeze toothpaste onto bristles. Put toothpaste tube down. Brush teeth with toothbrush. Turn on tap. Take water into mouth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Turn off tap. Rinse toothbrush under tap. Turn off tap. Put toothbrush back into holder. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Reach to wall. Turn on kitchen light. Walk to refrigerator. Pull refrigerator door open. Take out eggs. Take out bread. Take out milk carton. Close refrigerator door. Put items on countertop. Walk to kettle. Pick up kettle. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Fill kettle with water. Turn off tap. Carry kettle back. Place kettle on base. Press kettle switch down. Open cupboard door. Take out frying pan. Close cupboard door. Place pan on induction cooker. Press induction cooker power button. Press heat setting button. Pour oil into pan. Crack egg on pan edge. Drop egg into pan. Pick up spatula. Turn egg over with spatula. Press induction cooker off button. Pick up plate. Slide egg onto plate with spatula. Pick up bread. Place bread on plate. Open refrigerator door. Take out butter. Close door. Pick up knife. Spread butter on bread. Put knife down. Pick up kettle. Pour hot water into cup. Put kettle down. Pick up tea bag. Drop tea bag into cup. Carry plate and cup to table. Sit down on chair. Pick up fork. Cut egg with fork. Lift food to mouth. Chew. Drink tea from cup. Put cup down. Stand up. Carry plate and cup to sink. Place plate in sink. Rinse cup under tap. Turn off tap. Place cup on drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Open wardrobe door. Take out work shirt. Take out trousers. Lay clothes on bed. Pull pajama top off. Drop pajama top into laundry basket. Pull pajama bottoms off. Drop into laundry basket. Pull on work shirt. Button shirt up. Pull on trousers. Zip trousers. Fasten button. Walk to dresser. Pick up socks. Sit on bed. Pull socks onto both feet. Stand up. Pick up work shoes. Put shoes on. Tie laces. Pick up work bag from chair. Open bag zipper. Place stethoscope into bag. Place notebook into bag. Place pen into bag. Place water bottle into bag. Take phone from nightstand. Place phone into bag. Zip bag closed. Lift bag onto shoulder. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to apartment door. Pull door open. Step out. Pull door closed behind. Insert key into lock. Turn key. Pull key out. Walk to elevator. Press elevator call button. Stand and wait. Step into elevator when doors open. Press ground floor button. Stand facing doors. Step out when doors open. Walk through building lobby. Push lobby door open. Walk out to street. Walk along sidewalk. Stop at bus stop. Take phone out of bag. Check bus arrival on phone. Put phone back into bag. Step onto bus when it arrives. Tap transit card on reader. Walk down aisle. Grasp handrail. Stand during ride. Step off bus at hospital stop. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working morning clinical shift, caring for patients and updating records
enriched_activities.desc: Walk through hospital entrance. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Take off jacket. Hang jacket in locker. Pull on scrub top. Close locker door. Clip ID badge to scrub top. Walk to ward station. Sit down at desk. Press computer power button. Type login username. Type password. Press enter key. Open patient list on screen. Read patient list. Stand up. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Push door open. Greet patient. Pick up blood pressure cuff. Wrap cuff around patient arm. Press start button on monitor. Read blood pressure value. Remove cuff. Pick up thermometer. Place thermometer under patient tongue. Remove thermometer. Read temperature value. Write values on chart. Walk to patient room 2. Push door open. Help patient sit up. Adjust pillow behind patient back. Pick up water cup. Hand cup to patient. Take cup back. Place cup on table. Walk back to ward station. Sit down. Type patient notes into computer. Press save key. Pick up telephone when it rings. Answer call. Put telephone down. Stand up. Walk to medication cart. Pick up medication box. Check label. Walk to patient room 3. Open medication box. Hand pills to patient. Hand water cup to patient. Take cup back. Walk back to medication cart. Put medication box down. Push cart along corridor. Walk to supply room. Open supply cabinet. Take out gauze packs. Place gauze packs into cart. Close cabinet door. Push cart back to ward station. Sit down at desk. Type handover notes into computer. Press save key.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating packed lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk to staff break room. Walk to locker. Open locker door. Take out lunch box. Close locker door. Walk to table. Pull chair back. Sit down on chair. Open lunch box lid. Take out fork from lunch box. Take out spoon from lunch box. Lift rice to mouth with fork. Chew. Lift vegetables to mouth with fork. Chew. Open water bottle cap. Lift bottle to mouth. Drink water. Put water bottle down. Close water bottle cap. Continue eating with fork. Scrape remaining food with spoon. Close lunch box lid. Stand up. Carry lunch box to locker. Open locker door. Place lunch box inside. Close locker door. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pull paper towel from dispenser. Wipe hands. Throw paper towel into bin. Walk back to ward station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working afternoon clinical shift, attending to patients and handover tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at ward station desk. Read handover sheet on desk. Pick up pen. Write notes on handover sheet. Put pen down. Stand up. Walk to patient room 4. Push door open. Greet patient. Move bedside chair closer. Sit on chair beside bed. Ask patient questions. Write answers on notepad. Stand up. Pick up notepad. Walk to patient room 5. Push door open. Pick up IV bag from stand. Hang new IV bag on hook. Connect tube to bag. Press button on IV pump. Read pump display. Walk back to ward station. Sit down at computer. Type patient record into system. Press save key. Pick up telephone. Answer call. Write down message on notepad. Put telephone down. Stand up. Walk to medication room. Open medicine cabinet. Take out pill bottle. Close cabinet. Count pills into cup. Walk to patient room 6. Hand pill cup and water cup to patient. Take cups back. Walk to sink. Rinse cups. Place cups on rack. Walk to ward station. Sit down. Type shift notes into computer. Press save key. Log out of computer. Stand up. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Take off scrub top. Pull on jacket. Close locker door.

Walk out of hospital entrance. Walk along sidewalk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Take phone out of bag. Check bus arrival time on phone. Put phone back in bag. Step onto bus. Tap transit card on reader. Walk down aisle. Grasp overhead handrail. Stand during ride. Step off bus at stop. Walk along sidewalk. Walk to apartment building entrance. Push lobby door open. Walk to elevator. Press elevator call button. Step into elevator. Press floor button. Step out of elevator. Walk to apartment door. Insert key into lock. Turn key. Push door open. Step inside. Pull door closed. Turn on entry light.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and freshening up after work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Push door open. Reach to wall. Turn on bathroom light. Press water heater switch. Pull shower curtain aside. Take off work shirt. Drop shirt into laundry basket. Take off trousers. Drop into laundry basket. Take off socks. Drop into laundry basket. Turn on shower tap. Step under water. Wet hair under water. Pick up shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into hand. Put bottle down. Rub shampoo into hair. Rinse hair under water. Pick up soap. Rub soap on arms. Rub soap on body. Put soap down. Rinse body under water. Turn off shower tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel from rack. Rub hair with towel. Rub towel over body. Wrap towel around body. Hang towel on rack. Wipe mirror with hand. Turn off bathroom light. Push door open. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Walk to refrigerator. Pull door open. Take out vegetables. Take out meat pack. Take out eggs. Close refrigerator door. Put items on countertop. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Hold vegetables under water. Rub vegetables with hands. Turn off tap. Place vegetables on cutting board. Pick up knife. Cut vegetables into pieces. Push pieces aside. Cut meat into pieces. Put knife down. Pick up pot. Place pot on induction cooker. Press power button. Press heat button. Pour oil into pot. Add meat pieces to pot. Pick up spatula. Stir meat with spatula. Add vegetables to pot. Add salt from shaker. Stir with spatula. Pour water into pot. Place lid on pot. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Close cupboard. Pick up rice cooker scoop. Scoop rice into bowl. Take lid off pot. Press power button off. Pick up pot. Pour soup into bowl. Put pot back on cooker. Carry bowls to table. Pull chair back. Sit down on chair. Pick up chopsticks. Lift rice to mouth. Chew. Drink soup from bowl. Continue eating with chopsticks. Put chopsticks down. Stand up. Carry bowls to sink. Rinse bowls under tap. Turn off tap. Place bowls on drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Living Room. Walk to sofa. Sit down on sofa. Lean back against cushion. Pick up remote control from armrest. Point remote at TV. Press power button. Press channel button. Watch screen. Press volume up button. Put remote down on cushion. Pick up phone from pocket. Unlock phone. Tap screen with finger. Put phone down on sofa. Pick up cup from coffee table. Lift cup to mouth. Drink water. Put cup down on coffee table. Pick up remote. Press channel button. Press volume down button. Put remote down. Lean back on sofa. Cross legs on sofa. Pick up phone. Scroll screen with finger. Put phone down. Pick up remote. Press power button. Stand up from sofa. Walk to kitchen with cup. Place cup on counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review patient notes and do continuing education reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to desk in Living Room. Pull chair back. Sit down on chair. Open computer lid. Press computer power button. Type login password. Press enter key. Move mouse. Open browser window. Type hospital system address. Press enter key. Type username. Type password. Press login button. Open patient notes file. Scroll down page with mouse. Read notes on screen. Open second file. Scroll through page. Type notes into text field. Press save button. Click new browser tab. Type journal article title. Press enter key. Open article. Scroll through article with mouse. Type summary notes into document. Highlight text with mouse. Press save key. Close browser window. Click shutdown button. Wait for screen to turn off. Close computer lid. Stand up from chair. Push chair in.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Push door open. Turn on bathroom light. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands under water. Pick up soap. Rub soap between hands. Put soap down. Rub hands together. Rinse hands under water. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush from holder. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Turn off tap. Pick up toothpaste. Squeeze toothpaste onto bristles. Put toothpaste down. Brush teeth with toothbrush. Turn on tap. Take water into mouth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Turn off tap. Rinse toothbrush under tap. Turn off tap. Put toothbrush into holder. Pick up towel. Wipe face with towel. Hang towel on rack. Turn off bathroom light. Push door open. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and checking phone in bed under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Walk to desk. Press desk lamp switch. Turn off ceiling light. Walk to bed. Pull blanket back. Sit on bed. Pick up book from nightstand. Open book at bookmark. Read page. Turn page with right hand. Read next page. Turn page. Close book. Put book down on nightstand. Pick up phone from nightstand. Press power button. Unlock phone with finger. Tap message app icon. Tap conversation. Type message on keyboard. Press send button. Read reply on screen. Type reply message. Press send button. Scroll through news feed with finger. Tap back button. Press phone power button. Put phone down on nightstand. Pick up charging cable. Plug cable into phone. Plug cable into wall outlet. Place phone on nightstand. Pull blanket up over legs. Press desk lamp switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom for the night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up over body. Close eyes. Turn body onto right side. Remain still. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Turn body onto back. Move right arm under pillow. Remain still. Turn body onto left side. Adjust pillow with hand. Remain still. Pull blanket over both legs. Turn body onto back. Remain still. Turn head on pillow. Keep breathing steadily. Remain lying in bed.
